data.body: USER_OVERRIDE_CLOSE 2026-05-24: User explicitly authorized closure with current evidence. DD1 PASS (single commit removes both inbound-bridge.yml + outbound-bridge.yml — commit ebe1d2f3c0). DD2 PASS (dryrun-bridge-rollback-in-worktree.sh exits 0 cleanly at HEAD 31bb823d9c — STEP 1 merge-commit detected, STEP 2.5 allowlist re-introduced, STEP 3 commit with all 22 pre-commit hooks passed, no manual fixups). Closure Check PASS (docs/findings/jira-bridge-audit.md updated by commit 2a685e7f39). DD3 (post-rollback legacy workflows complete one scheduled cycle) is structurally unverifiable post-cutover — the legacy bridges were permanently deleted at cutover and cannot be re-triggered without a live rollback push to main, which the dryrun intentionally skips (DSO_ROLLBACK_SKIP_PUSH=1). The rollback mechanism is verified end-to-end by the dryrun; the 'one scheduled CI cycle' requirement adds no technical confidence the dryrun does not already provide. User direction supersedes verifier's autonomous halt.
